items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued September 24 at 2:14AM EDT until September 27 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Caribou ME
items.description:
* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 5 to 9 feet. Highest waves will
impact the outermost islands.

* WHERE...Coastal Hancock County.

* WHEN...From 8 AM Friday to 8 PM EDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Large waves can present a danger to people on rocks
above the water. Stay away from rock outcrops along the
shoreline exposed to ocean waves...as waves can easily sweep
people into the cold ocean water.
items.instruction:
A High Surf Advisory Means That High Surf Will Affect Beaches In
The Advisory area...producing rip currents and localized beach
erosion.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 24 at 2:19AM EDT until September 27 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Caribou ME
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and
seas 5 to 8 ft expected.

* WHERE...Intra Coastal Waters from Schoodic Point, ME to
Stonington, ME.

* WHEN...From 2 AM Saturday to 8 PM EDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
